# brethof-llms-txt

> A Python tool that generates and maintains an llms.txt file for GitHub repositories by reading READMEs and documentation folders.

It runs on Python 3.11+ with no external dependencies and can be used via a GitHub App, GitHub Action, or command line. The tool structures links based on project navigation and uses a model to write descriptions, ensuring the file stays current with documentation changes.

## Docs

- [brethof-llms-txt](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/brethof-llms-txt/main/README.md): Generates and maintains an llms.txt file from repository documentation, using deterministic structure and optional model-written descriptions.
- [How the GitHub App works](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BrethofAI/brethof-llms-txt/main/docs/github-app.md): How the app generates the first file, schedules updates, and handles pull requests versus direct commits.
